reason: CAM estimates which intermediate outputs in multi-agent code-generation systems causally affect correctness and demonstrates repair and feature-pruning applications. Evaluations span agent systems/backends and code datasets; the paper is an analysis framework, not an inference-cost optimization, and results depend on simulated errors and selected systems. Potential agent-token pruning is adjacent but not established as a serving improvement.
title: CAM: A Causality-Based Analysis Framework for Multi-agent Code Generation Systems
